title: Ordinary evaluation for a bounded finite-projective complex
statement: For a ringed site with independent universes, a bounded complex K carrying a degreewise finite-free-retract package, and any complex F, the specified ordinary signed total evaluation ringedSiteOrdinaryEvaluation K F is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08JJ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex, final paragraph: finite diagonal evaluation calculation

proof.text: Project the degree n ordinary evaluation to each Hom-product factor. Outside the finite support interval of K the factor is zero; on the factor indexed by a supported term, the map is the canonical sheaf-module evaluation F^(a+n) tensor Hom(K^a,O) to Hom(K^a,F^(a+n)).

For a finite free term the canonical evaluation is inverted by the finite dual-basis sum. Naturality restricts this inverse along the given finite-free retraction, so every supported diagonal factor is invertible. Since the diagonal is finite, the total degree map is invertible; the specified ordinary map is already a chain map, hence the complex morphism is an isomorphism.

theorem ringedSiteOrdinaryEvaluation_isIso
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n))
    (pkg : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite _ K)
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    IsIso (ringedSiteOrdinaryEvaluation.{c, v, r} J R K F)
